title: Shortest path in a grid (BFS)
summary: Find the fewest steps from the top-left to the bottom-right of a grid with walls, exploring in rings.
note: Moves go up, down, left or right; # is a wall. -1 means there's no path.

The start or the goal is a wall, so there's no path.
